messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow the dose escalation schedule below to minimize gastrointestinal adverse reactions.
Initial Wegovy Injection Dose Escalation Schedule (all indications):
Week 1 to week 4: 0.25mg once a week
Week 5 to week 8: 0.5mg once a week
Week 9 to week 12: 1mg once a week
Week 13 to week 16: 1.7mg once a week
Maintenance injection dose guidance:
Adult weight reduction maintenance dose:
1.7 mg or 2.4 mg (recommended) injected subcutaneously once weekly.
Dose may be increased to 7.2 mg subcutaneously once weekly.
This increase applies to patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks.
The increase is also required when additional weight reduction is clinically indicated.
Maximum dose 7.2 mg once weekly
Consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage
Pediatric patients' weight reduction maintenance dose (patients aged 12 years and older):
Either 2.4 mg (recommended) or 1.7 mg once weekly.
Consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage
Cardiovascular risk reduction maintenance dose:
Triplet: ["Semaglutide", "has dose increase condition", "patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks"]

The relation 'has dose increase condition' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may have specific conditions under which the dose can be increased.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose increment': The subject drug's dose is increased by the specified amount at regular intervals.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
C. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
E. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
